body:
--- Pre Tourney Crap ---



Well, my and my friend were unsure that we were going to be going to this tourney (all

going to be our first tourney), because of a number of issues, ranging from my friends

guitar lesson to my mom not liking people in general because she is a paranoid skitzo.

anyway, I was doubtful we were going until I walked into the store, but happy that I got

to go (finally!)



--- end pre tourney crap ---



Decks: for the darkside I was packing my saber in your eye huntdown, mines the your

eyes can deceive you, so it was just a regular hunt down that I’m never using again.



for the lightside, I played my non WYS harvest, with 7 harvests, and it was really fun.



Ok, this is my first tourney, and therefore first tourney report, so go easy on me.

obviously, I am unrated going into this tourney.



YAY I GOT A RATING, ITS ABOUT TIME. ok, I’m very sorry, I’ve just been waiting 3

years for a tourney to be near me :-)



ok, onto the games



Game 1 my DS vs. Gennaro (not sure of his last name, but he’s a really cool, laid back "I

don’t care if I win" guy) 15?? not sure, he didn’t say what his rating was, just that it was

in the 1500s. he was playing random scrubs in random places



well, he started the hoth war room, and I’m thinking EBO, a wacky ebo. and I do my hunt

down stuff, and didn’t draw a vader, but otherwise a good hand. I drew my BB vader in

the first force I drew, first turn, lost to visage, and made him lose too. he just went about

deploying random sites on tatooine, including the moisture farm, which had me thinking

harvest, but it wasn’t harvest. had me really freaked out. he deployed random 2/2 scrubs,

and a madine to the farm, as well as a CoK and a scrub to the audience chamber. he

managed to do about 10 force in drains, maybe less to me through out the game, all the

while I beat down on his scrubs, crossed Luke with some tracked 6’s, and let visage eat

him. not a real active game, but I had fun and won my first ever sanctioned game, by a

whole 19 cards! gasp, I’m not too bad :-)



Full Win: 2(+19)



Good: beating up on madine with clash of saber and all that good stuff, and winning my

first game



Bad: relatively inactive game



Ugly: Gennaro’s deck, it was kinda sloppy, but you’ll get better, Gennaro.





Game 2 my LS vs. Jason McSherry 1700 something’s MKOS abyssians



well, Jason had MAJOR problems with his MKOS deck, including no abyssians, no abby

ornaments, and several other key cards he forgot to put in, as he rushed to just throw 20

cards in at the last second, which cost him the game. he basically deploy a bunch of guys

on the sail barge, and ran around, while draining at the AC, and the lower passages. I was

harvesting like crazy, getting 8 of them off over the game (I only managed to play one

before something special planned for them hit the table). I drained for about 10-15 force

the whole game, while he drained for about 30 some, all thanks to gailid, but I played 8

harvests, and retrieved a WHOLE lot. I placed boelo and xizor out of play with OOC/TT,

and it was all good. the biggest battle of the game occurred when he had xizor, boelo, a

merc pilot, bib, snoova, and djas puhr on the sail barge, and he initiated against my  lone

jedi Luke w/ saber, and freshly stole vibro axe. he retrieved his two for scum (which he

did about 3-4 time over the course of the game, very annoying), and I promptly played

fallen portal, targeting the merc, and boelo, praying for a good draw. I get a 4, and with

the +2, they are both lost, and he’s suddenly screwed. he gets a 2 for his destiny, and I

think that I draw either a 2, or a random 6, but I’m not sure which. anyway, I end up

losing Luke, with his saber and axe, and one more, or something like that. Luke never

comes back (none of the 3 in the deck :-( ) and I just drain with Ben at the farm (and his

saber too) while he drains for about 6 a turn, and I’m getting 4 back. I beat down on him

once or twice, but in the end, it was the 7 harvests that won it. we had time called, and I

had played my second to last harvest, and we counted up the cards in our decks, I had 35,

he had 19, so I get the timed win.



Timed Win: 3 (+54)



Good: Jason forgetting so many key cards



Bad: Jason forgetting so many key cards



Ugly: Jason forgetting so many key cards





Game 3 My DS vs. James Leiser 1850 or so’s WYS mega tech



well, James is a great player, despite his rating. he’s the one that enlightened me, and

taught me how to track, so he’s basically my mentor. he had MEGA tech in this deck,

with lots of admiral orders, which I couldn’t grab, and they added to his drains at the

DBays he had. he was draining for about 6 a turn, killing my activation, and beating me

in all the battles we had. I got about 3 or 4 drains with vader and tarkin at the cantina

with vaders saber, then down came menace, and then bargining table, so that hurt too. I

tracked two sixes for Mara to duel jedi Luke w/ saber, he had @#$%ty draws, but we tied (I

had a spare visage in hand, which I was gonna track, and I thought nah, I don’t need the

extra overkill, DOH!) so nothing happened, except he beat down on Mara jade with some

extra destiny thanks to ralltiir freighter cappys, and I sucked really bad in this game. he

played the regular TT, so my this is some rescue did nothing, and I royally crapped my

pants when he canceled visage twice. I did land one good battle on his falcon w/ ECC

lando and dash. I put a foily lateral damage on it, and then battled with fett in slave one. I

drew a tracked 7, but his AO made my total power 12, and he drew two 6s for destiny, so

I got rid of his ECC lando, but lost my slave one. closest I ever came to winning a battle

against James. he drained a bunch more, and I drew up in the end. full loss by 24.



Full Loss: 3(30)



Good: umm, playing James because he is just generally cool



Bad: Mara tying Luke in the duel



Ugly: James’ Regular transmission terminated



at this point, I’m 3 with +30 so I’m totally happy, and I go into my next game with

broken confidence, as its against the TD, and I just generally feel bad from losing against

James, but I knew he was easily the best player there.





Game 4: my LS vs. Mike Carr 1500 something’s endor ops no flip



well, this game was an incredible matchup. he had something special planned for him (I

played the only people who had it, just about, it sooooo figures) but it didn’t matter

much. he got to space quick, and decreed, but not before I managed about 20 force or

more in drains from the cantina and other tatooine locations with my lightsabers. all the

time, he was doing 7 in drains for about 5 turns, but every turn (mine and his) I was

playing harvests. in the meanwhile, I forgot to drain twice, for 4 force each time, which

sucked. we had but one battle, and it was late in the game, when he had about 5 force

left, and I had 3, and it was corran and kal fal, vs. choke vader, I initiated. it was my last

ditch effort to make him lose force. I was PRAYING for a 6 which there were a ton of in

the deck, but I pulled a 2, and I lost the battle by one, so I lost kal fal, he lost nothing, and

that was about it. he drained me for 7 next turn and killed me. there were several things

that would have gotten me the win (and second or third place for that matter). I could

have drained for those 8 (I even had DRAIN written on my hand in black permanent

marker...HOW COULD I FORGET! they was the only times I forgot to drain, how

scrubbish) and I could have grabbed that last harvest instead of I hope she’s alright from

my force pile with tunnel vision, but no, I decided to be a scrub and lose by 5, when I

should have won.



Full Loss: 3(+25)



Good: HARVEST



Bad: something special for them



Ugly: me not draining...ugh



well, all in all the tourney was great, and I had lots of fun. I didn’t do too bad, and I came

in 9th out of 14 (instead of 2nd, DOH!) oh well, ill be there next month. James won,

going undefeated, but I’m not sure of who else placed where.



Props and Slops:



Props:

To me for getting my goal of 2-2 in my first tourney

To James for winning

To Mike Carr for running a GREAT tourney, and giving away such great prize support

from his own collection

To Jason McSherry, for being a great guy to play against

To Gennaro, for me forgetting your name, and you being so relaxed

To my dad for driving me, after many hours of begging





Slops:

To Will for coming in dead last and being happy about doing so

To me for not draining like the scrub I am

To James for winning

To James for playing a regular TT instead of the Combo





thanks for remembering that this was my first tourney report, and going easy on me :-)



--Loaf

summary: Geoff Gallo-Cornell, in his first tournament, finished 9th of 14 at a tournament in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, on 24 February 2001, going 2–2 with a Hunt Down deck and Harvest; James Leiser won undefeated.
notes: Unnamed store event run by Mike Carr; 'Amish tourney' is from the posted title. Named 'February 2001 Lancaster tournament' (no Lancaster event on the List).
'Mike Carr' = [[Michael Carr]] (Mike Carr redirects there; the page says he was a Pennsylvania tournament director).
Game 2 margin not stated: the running total goes from 2(+19) to 3(+54) (+35) and the timed win is 35 cards to 19, so margin left null. Game 3 printed '3(30)' (= +30); game 4 'lose by 5'.
Round 1 opponent known only as 'Gennaro' (rating in the 1500s): no page.
Jason McSherry and James Leiser linked by name (small-world rule). Leiser 'won, going undefeated'.
'Will' came in 'dead last' (recorded as 14th of 14); first name only, no page.

Author's 'Saber In Your Eye' has DeckTech pages from December 2000 (v1–v3); the version played is not stated, so deck_page null. His 'Loaf's TIGIHarvest' (1 March 2001) is TIGIH-based, not this non-WYS Harvest, so not linked.
Body contains the archive's '@#$%' censoring as printed.
